            "start": c["start"],

            "score": c["score"],
            "replacement": c["replacement_tokens"]

    intervals.sort(key=lambda x: x["end"])
    n = len(intervals)
    # DP array: dp[i] = best score using intervals[:i+1] (sorted by end)

    # Also store previous index to reconstruct

    # For each interval, find last non-overlapping

        # Find last interval that ends <= current start
        # Binary search on end values
        lo, hi = 0, i
        while lo < hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            if intervals[mid]["end"] <= intervals[i]["start"]:
                lo = mid + 1
            else:
                hi = mid
        # lo is first interval that ends > start; so last non-overlap is lo-1
        last_non = lo - 1
        # Score if include this interval
        include_score = intervals[i]["score"] + (dp[last_non] if last_non >= 0 else 0.0)
        # Score if exclude (dp[i-1])

            prev[i] = last_non

            prev[i] = -2  # indicating exclude
    # Reconstruct selected intervals

    i = n-1

        # add replacement
        new_tokens.extend(iv["replacement"])
        pos = e
    # add remaining
